provenance: Original isolated virtual HP Prime G1 firmware. No physical verification or vendor code, font or screenshot bytes bundled.

controls.source: EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); Spreadsheet.F1:=42; RETURN STRING({F1(2),Spreadsheet.F1(2),TYPE(F1(2)),F1(0),Spreadsheet.F1}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); Spreadsheet.F1(2):="FN_CELL"; RETURN STRING({F1(2),Spreadsheet.F1(2),TYPE(F1(2)),Spreadsheet.F1}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); RETURN STRING({Function.F1(2),Function.F2(2),F1(2),Spreadsheet.F1(2)}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Function"); RETURN STRING({F1(2),TYPE(F1(2)),F1(#FF:8h),TYPE(F1(#FF:8h)),F1({1,2}),TYPE(F1({1,2}))}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Function"); RETURN F1({1,2}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Function"); HComplex:=1; AComplex:=1; RETURN F1((1,2)); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Function"); RETURN F1(#FF:8h); END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); X:=99; RETURN {Function.F1(2),Function.F2(2),X}; END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN HAngle:=1; STARTAPP("Function"); AAngle:=1; RETURN {F3(90),HAngle,AAngle}; END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN HAngle:=1; STARTAPP("Function"); AAngle:=1; STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); AAngle:=3; RETURN {Function.F3(90),HAngle,AAngle}; END;
EXPORT ZZT_FCALL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); X:=99; RETURN {F1(2),F2(2),X}; END;

limitations: Function definition reads and writes, other app function families, and Function calls from worksheet cell formulas are not implemented by this service.
Foreign-caller Function bodies retain caller app name resolution and app calculation settings. Worksheet content itself uses Spreadsheet settings.
Unallocated versus allocated cell names are controlled; names on format-only or previously cleared cells need further original firmware controls.
